title: Stinger from Zelda: Ocarina of Time
description: This resource pack replaces phantoms by Stingers from Zelda Ocarina of Time!
body:
This resource pack replaces phantoms by Stingers from Zelda Ocarina of Time!

This mob appeared in Jabu Jabu's belly, and in the Water Temple!

Optifine (forge), or entity textures & models features is required (fabric)!
